name: Jannes
overview: Jannes is a male figure identified in the New Testament as a magician who opposed Moses. The Scriptures highlight his role as an adversary to God's appointed leader during the Exodus period, emphasizing his opposition through magical arts. No tribal affiliation or additional personal notes are provided in the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Jannes' appears as a proper name in 2 Timothy 3:8 without any specific meaning or divine origin noted. It is simply the name by which this individual is known in Scripture.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Jannes beyond his identification as a magician opposing Moses. No relatives or connections are mentioned in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jannes is significant in the biblical narrative as a representative of false opposition to God's work through Moses. His role as a magician who resisted God's authority illustrates the conflict between divine power and counterfeit signs. This opposition serves as a warning to believers about the dangers of following those who mimic God's power without His authority.
